logline: 눈먼 아버지의 눈을 뜨게 하려고, 딸이 뱃사람들에게 제 몸을 판다.
protagonist: 댕기머리에 무명 치마저고리를 입은 열다섯 소녀
setting: 조선 시대, 가난한 초가와 포구와 바다
anchor: a Korean girl of fifteen, one long braid, plain undyed hemp jeogori and skirt
palette: ink-wash grey, hanji cream, lotus pink, lantern amber, cold pale spray

blind_father.label: 심봉사
blind_father.desc: a thin Korean man in his fifties, pale unfocused eyes turned slightly upward, sparse grey beard, patched hemp coat, bamboo cane
blind_father.avoid: 안대·천으로 눈을 가리지 않는다. 'blind' 같은 개념어를 묘사에 쓰면 모델이 안대를 그린다

sailors.label: 뱃사람들
sailors.desc: Korean sailors in short hemp jackets and rolled trousers, white head cloths, bare feet, ropes coiled

simcheong_girl.label: 심청
simcheong_girl.desc: a Korean girl of fifteen, one long black braid with a plain cord, undyed hemp jeogori and skirt, bare feet

beats.beat: 소녀가 눈먼 아버지의 손을 잡아 이끈다.
beats.visual: a girl leading a blind old man by the hand along a village path past a thatched hut
beats.motion: they walk forward along the path, his cane taps ahead, her sleeve tugs his hand

beats.visual: a blind old man floundering waist-deep in a cold village stream, cane floating away
beats.motion: he flails in the water toward the bank, the cane drifts off, reeds whip

beats.visual: weathered sailors facing a young girl on a stone quay, a heavy junk moored behind them
beats.motion: the sailors step toward her, ropes swing off the quay, the hull rocks

beats.visual: a girl setting a small rice table beside a sleeping old man in a dim thatched room
beats.motion: she sets the bowl down on the table, steam rises, the lamp flame dips

beats.visual: a girl at a junk's rail looking back at a receding shore, sailors hauling ropes
beats.motion: the ship pulls away from the shore, the sail fills, her braid whips back

beats.beat: 거친 바다 위에서 소녀가 두 손을 모은다.
beats.visual: a girl standing at a ship's rail with hands clasped above heaving black waves
beats.motion: waves heave up against the hull, spray bursts over the rail, her skirt snaps

beats.beat: 바다 한가운데 커다란 연꽃 한 송이가 떠오른다.
beats.visual: an enormous pink lotus blossom rising on open sea, closed petals, mist on the water
beats.motion: the lotus rises up through the surface, water sheets off the petals, mist parts

beats.visual: an empty wooden ship deck at dawn, coiled ropes, wet planks, grey open sea beyond
beats.motion: water runs across the planks, the ropes shift, the sail slackens overhead

withheld: 연꽃에서 나온 심청이 왕비가 되고, 잔치에서 아버지가 눈을 뜨는 결말
